metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: AI-Dating privacy policy explaining how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.p1: Welcome to AI-Dating ("we," "our," or "the platform"). We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information.
introduction.p2: By using our services, you agree to the practices described in this privacy policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use our services.

account.label: Account information
account.text: username, email address, password (stored in encrypted form)

profile.label: Profile
profile.text: display name, avatar, bio, location, website link

content.label: Content
content.text: posts, comments, likes, follows, and other activity you publish

communication.label: Communication
communication.text: direct messages you send and your notification preferences

usage.label: Usage data
usage.text: IP address, browser type, device information, and operating system

cookies.label: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.text: session cookies, preferences, and analytics data

logs.label: Log data
logs.text: access times, page views, and clickstream data

social.label: Social media
social.text: when you choose to sign in through a social provider

analytics.label: Analytics services
analytics.text: aggregated data provided by services such as Google Analytics

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

service.label: Provide the service
service.text: create and manage your account and surface content

improve.label: Improve the service
improve.text: analyze usage patterns and optimize the user experience

communication.label: Communication
communication.text: send notifications, updates, and optional marketing messages

security.label: Security
security.text: detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security threats

compliance.label: Compliance
compliance.text: meet legal obligations and enforce our terms

sharing.title: 4. Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information in the following situations:

public.title: 4.1 Public Information
public.text: Your profile, published content, and comments are public by default and may be viewed by anyone. You can adjust visibility in your privacy settings.

providers.title: 4.2 Service Providers
providers.intro: We rely on third-party providers to help operate the platform:

legal.title: 4.3 Legal Requirements
legal.text: We may disclose your information when required by law or when necessary to protect our rights, property, or safety.

transfer.title: 4.4 Business Transfers
transfer.text: If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.intro: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information:

items.passwords: Passwords are encrypted using industry-standard practices such as bcrypt
items.https: HTTPS is used to encrypt data in transit
items.audits: Regular security reviews and vulnerability scans
items.backup: Data backup and disaster recovery planning

security.outro: However, no method of transmission over the internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.intro: If you are located in the European Union, you may have the following rights:

access.label: Right of access
access.text: request access to the personal data we hold about you

rectification.label: Right to rectification
rectification.text: request correction of inaccurate personal data

erasure.label: Right to erasure
erasure.text: request deletion of your personal data

restriction.label: Right to restriction
restriction.text: request that we limit how your personal data is processed

portability.label: Right to data portability
portability.text: receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format

object.label: Right to object
object.text: object to the processing of your personal data

rights.contactPrefix: To exercise these rights, visit your

cookies.title: 7. Cookie Policy
cookies.p1Prefix: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience. For more details, please read our
cookies.p2: You can manage your cookie preferences in your browser settings or through our cookie consent banner.

retention.title: 8. Data Retention
retention.intro: We retain your personal information until one of the following applies:

items.service: the data is no longer needed to provide the service
items.legal: the legally required retention period expires

retention.outro: After account deletion, your data may be anonymized, though certain information may be retained for auditing and compliance purposes.

children.title: 9. Children’s Privacy
children.text: Our services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has provided us with information, please contact us.

international.title: 10. International Data Transfers
international.text: Your information may be transferred to and processed on servers outside your country or region. We take steps to ensure your data is handled securely in accordance with this privacy policy.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will post the new policy on this page and update the "last updated" date. For material changes, we may also notify you by email or on the site.

contact.intro: If you have questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact us:
